DIAGNOSIS READY: Dyspareunia (likely vaginismus or vulvodynia) secondary to Body Dysmorphic Disorder.

I have noted your history of Body Dysmorphic Disorder, which is a significant risk factor for pelvic floor dysfunction and pain during penetration. Given that your pelvic ultrasound results are pending, I will be reviewing those images shortly to rule out any anatomical causes, but your symptoms strongly suggest a psychosomatic etiology related to muscle tension and anxiety about body image. Do you feel that thoughts about your appearance or body image often interfere with your sexual intimacy?
